notes: Per-section-leaf convention (analogous to WI 2025 Example D in pass-2 prompt). Chapter 49 snapshot exposes section-level statute URLs directly, no further depth. Selected the 17 sections that constitute the NPADA lobbying body (49-1480 through 49-1492.01). Regime prior cited §§49-1480 through 49-1492.06; sections .02-.06 of 49-1492 do not appear in the 2025 Justia index (either never enacted or transferred), so the actual range is 49-1480 through 49-1492.01. Definitions (49-1403 et seq.) and Nebraska Accountability and Disclosure Commission infrastructure (49-14,105 et seq.) live in the same Chapter 49 but apply to all four NPADA regimes (campaign finance, lobbying, financial disclosure, conflicts of interest) — not lobbying-specific — so omitted to keep proposed_urls tight to the lobbying disclosure body, mirroring the WI 2025 and MA 2025 conventions.
